[person] complaining of pain to his right hip. i observed the vehicle, later identified as unit 1, a blue 2014 chevrolet malibu, bearing texas tag #:[identifier] (vin: 1g11b5sl9ef249011), parked south of the main entrance, facing west. the vehicle was halfway reversed from the parking location. i did not observe any blood or damages on the vehicle. the driver of the vehicle, later identified as willis, dianne (dob: [date]), advised she was backing out of the parking spot and did not observe anyone behind her vehicle. [person] she looked both directions and was using her rear view mirror. [person] she had her daughter, later identified as dalme, kaylee (dob: [date]), in her front right passenger side. no airbags were deployed inside the vehicle and no medical assistance was needed for [person] her daughter. [person]`s wife, later identified as mcarthur ryane (dob: [date]), stated she was leaving the business and was following directly behind her husband. [person] she witnessed her husband get struck on his right side and immediately fell to the ground. [person] the driver of the vehicle stayed at the scene. atascocita ems medic # [medical facility] where he was treated for non-life threatening injuries. i observed [person] up and get on to the medical stretcher to be treated by ems at the scene. i provided both parties with the hcso [case id]. (sfst's). unit 1 driver arrested for driving while intoxicated. see officer pierson dwi report for further details. there was minor front end damage to unit 1. unit 2 advised that he was okay and did not suffer any injuries from the accident. ems did not make the location. unit 2 driver was provided a [case id]. unit 1 was towed to growdon impound.
